profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Results driven, self-motivated team player, eager to apply +12 years of experience in diverse environments of software architecture, Providing solutions using the latest technology and resources within budget and time constraints with strong communication and problem solving skills.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working in Azure Functions Release and Deployment.

positions.title: Engineering Architect
positions.description:
My responsibilities include: 

Analyze business strategy and determine system architecture requirements to achieve business goals.
Lead teams to plan, design, and implement applications.
Formulate strategic plans for software development to sustain future project objectives thru collaboration.
Gather detailed business requirements and use cases, and translate them into technical specifications.
Write and implement prototypes for new features.
Implementation of standards in existing applications and software development process.
Address performance issues on existing applications.
Progressively reduce tech debt thru implementation of best practices.

Environment:
Ruby on Rails, ReactJS, IBM Cloudant, Amazon Web Services, Heroku, Redis to name a few.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
My responsibilities include research and development of new features, bug fixes, technology stack maintenance and upgrades, peer code reviews, integration with 3rd party APIs, optimization and scalability, testing and time estimation.

Environment:
Ruby on Rails, Rspec, HTML5, jQuery, jRuby
ElasticSearch, Couchdb, PostgreSQL, Redis, 
Heroku, 3Scale, AWS, among other technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
●	Ongoing R&D for feature requests, maintenance, and bug fixes
●	Develop additional modules for vendor specific functionality
●	Collaborate with team members and direct resources to design and implement custom, client-specific features
●	Assist other developers with technological issues and guidance pertaining to:
○	SQL query design and optimization
○	Data model design
○	JavaScript/jQuery
○	CSS 2/3 
○	Code optimization and scalability
Environment: HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, PHP 5, CodeIgniter (MVC), SQL Server 2008, MySQL 5 (InnoDB/MyISAM), SSRS, SVN, Apache, FileZilla, CentOS, BeyondCompare

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
•	As a lead engineer, project managed and implemented full building cabling, networking, wan, lan and vpn configuration, email, web and application servers, on-time and within budget.
•	Provided multi tier customer support to 50+ users internationally.
•	Develop an internet customer portal for checking real-time information about shipments in php,jquery ajax, and mysql..
•	Developed custom edi software for invoicing and real time information exchange with customers in vb .net, powerbuilder and mysql.
•	Developed a zend framework application for controlling the vendor managed inventory on hand.

positions.title: IT Manager and Lead Programmer
positions.description:
Application design and implementation.
Propietary GPS tracking systems it architect
IT Infrastructure design and maintenance
Oracle / MSSQL database administrator
Flex 3, .Net , Powerbuilder, Java Programmer

positions.title: Software architect
positions.description: Database replication over the internet, medical system development, site to site replication between oracle databases.
